summary: Leassh runs on Windows, Apple Silicon macOS, and Linux computers. It does not run on phones or tablets.

platforms.name: Windows
platforms.notes: Run PowerShell as Administrator. The agent and local server are supported.

platforms.name: macOS
platforms.notes: Apple Silicon only. Intel Mac support is not available yet.

platforms.name: Linux
platforms.notes: Debian, Ubuntu, Fedora, Arch, and similar distributions.

platforms.name: Android
platforms.notes: Leassh does not run on Android. Use Google Family Link for Android phones and tablets.

platforms.name: iOS and iPadOS
platforms.notes: Leassh does not run on iPhone or iPad. Use Apple Screen Time for those devices.

platforms.name: ChromeOS
platforms.notes: Leassh does not run on Chromebooks. Use Google Family Link for ChromeOS supervision.

dashboard.note: The dashboard is served by your own Leassh server. There is no hosted dashboard.

companions.name: Google Family Link
companions.note: Use Family Link for phones, tablets, and Chromebooks.

companions.name: Apple Screen Time
companions.note: Use Screen Time for iPhone and iPad limits and reports.
